description:
Marcus Retires helps retirees and seniors navigate the confusing
world of retirement finances — in plain, simple language.

From Social Security and Medicare to hidden tax rules, 401(k)
mistakes, IRA traps, and bills you may no longer need to pay —
we break down the topics that can save (or cost) you thousands.

💡 What You'll Learn Here:
✅ Retirement tax rules most people never hear about
✅ Social Security & Medicare secrets that actually matter
✅ Bills and costs you can legally stop paying
✅ Property, downsizing & estate planning mistakes to avoid
✅ Bank & account rules every retiree and surviving spouse must know
✅ Simple money moves to protect your hard-earned savings

🔔 New videos every week — Subscribe & hit the bell so
you never miss a video that could save you thousands.

Your retirement. Your money. Your rules.

#Retirement #SocialSecurity #Medicare #Taxes #MarcusRetires
